site_title: TanStarter Cloud | Ship your next Cloudflare product
site_description: A reusable TanStack Start and Cloudflare starter with Better Auth, Google One Tap, Pancake billing, D1 persistence, and an administrator workspace.
social_image_alt: TanStarter Cloud preview showing its reusable full-stack product workflow.
hero_badge: A REUSABLE PRODUCT FOUNDATION · CLOUDFLARE NATIVE
hero_description: A production-shaped starter for your next SaaS or AI tool: Google auth, One Tap, billing, D1, queues, R2, Durable Objects, Workers AI, analytics, and an admin workspace.
hero_note: React 19 · TanStack Start · Cloudflare full stack
stack_title: A familiar stack, trimmed to the essentials
stack_description: Development and production use the same modern tools. Each Cloudflare service has one clear responsibility and one typed integration boundary.
stack_react_detail: A current component model, without an app-state framework added by default.
stack_tanstack_detail: File-based routing and server rendering for a simple site that loads fast and can be indexed.
stack_i18n_detail: Type-safe multilingual messages with localized URLs.
stack_cloudflare_detail: Workers, D1, KV, R2, Queues, Durable Objects, Workers AI, and Analytics Engine are wired as explicit bindings.
architecture_title: The structure stays clear as the site grows
architecture_description: Routes handle pages and webhooks. Components handle presentation. Server functions own private data. D1 is the source of truth; Queue and Durable Objects make asynchronous and serialized work explicit.
architecture_routes_detail: The home page, its Spanish and French versions, and SEO endpoints for machines.
architecture_components_detail: Focused building blocks for layout, themes, and the landing page.
architecture_content_detail: Every visible string has a source message for each supported locale.
architecture_delivery_detail: Build with Vite, then deploy to Cloudflare Workers on workers.dev.
template_title: Change four things. Make it yours
template_description: This starter is made to be taken apart. Product identity and copy live in predictable places, while auth, billing, and admin operations stay behind reusable server boundaries.
template_step_1_detail: Update the central website configuration and replace the brand assets.
template_step_2_detail: Use the source messages for each supported locale to tell your own story.
template_step_3_detail: Reorder or remove homepage sections, then adjust the theme tokens.
template_step_4_detail: Connect your custom domain when your site is ready.
faq_1_q: What does this full-stack starter include?
faq_1_a: It includes Better Auth with Google OAuth and One Tap, D1-backed sessions and application data, Pancake checkout and webhook projection, a reusable admin surface, and Cloudflare service bindings.
faq_2_a: Yes. TanStack Router is already in place, so you can add an About, Docs, or Contact page when you need one. Those pages are not included by default.
faq_3_q: Which services are wired by default?
faq_3_a: Workers, D1, KV, R2, Queues, Durable Objects, Workers AI, and Analytics Engine are declared in Wrangler. Replace the placeholder resource IDs and add secrets before deployment.
faq_4_q: Can I use my own domain?
faq_4_a: Yes. Start on workers.dev, then connect a custom domain whenever your site is ready.
closing_title: Start with the whole product surface
closing_description: Keep the public site easy to understand while the reusable server boundaries handle identity, billing, and operations as your product grows.
footer_tagline: A reusable full-stack product starter for Cloudflare Workers.
page_about_meta_description: A short overview page for the TanStarter Cloud starter template.
page_about_title: A simple starting point for your next product
page_about_description: TanStarter Cloud is a reusable public-site and Cloudflare application starter. Keep this page brief, then replace it with your product story when the project is ready.
page_about_section_scope_body: Use this space to explain who the product is for, what it does, and why it exists. The default copy stays generic so each project can define its own positioning.
page_about_section_customize_body: Replace the template wording with your real company, product, team, contact, and trust details before sending production traffic here.
page_privacy_meta_description: A generic privacy policy placeholder for projects built from TanStarter Cloud.
page_privacy_description: This starter includes a simple privacy page so every public site has a clear place for privacy terms. Replace it with policy text that matches your product.
page_privacy_section_overview_body: Describe what information your product collects, why it is collected, and how people can contact you with privacy questions.
page_privacy_section_services_body: List the providers your product actually uses for hosting, authentication, payments, analytics, email, storage, and support.
page_privacy_section_update_body: Before launch, replace this placeholder with a policy reviewed for your product, market, data flows, and legal requirements.
page_terms_meta_description: A generic terms of service placeholder for projects built from TanStarter Cloud.
page_terms_description: This starter includes a basic terms page so each project has a visible legal route from day one. Replace it with terms that match your product and business model.
page_terms_section_template_body: These terms are only a starting point. They should not be treated as final legal terms for a real product.
page_terms_section_owner_body: Add your company name, contact details, user rules, billing terms, refund policy, support commitments, and jurisdiction before launch.
page_terms_section_update_body: Keep the date current whenever you replace or update the terms for the product you are shipping.
